long_biography.plain_text:
A fragrance encountered during his travels helped give Benzion “Benny” Aboud a new business idea. He had already built Saveology, a South Florida platform that marketed home and technology services to consumers. With fragrance specialist Farah Abassi, he developed a scenting business that adapted cold-air diffusion for homes and larger commercial spaces.

Aboud leads Aroma360 and its hotel-inspired sister brand from Miami. Their collections began with room scents and diffuser systems, then extended into candles, personal perfume and other lifestyle products. Alongside direct consumer sales, the companies create tailored scents for hotels and other commercial clients. Aroma360 also developed a collection of home and car fragrances for professional basketball teams.
long_biography.html:
A fragrance encountered during his travels helped give Benzion “Benny” Aboud a new business idea. He had already built Saveology, a South Florida platform that marketed home and technology services to consumers. With fragrance specialist Farah Abassi, he developed a scenting business that adapted cold-air diffusion for homes and larger commercial spaces.

Aboud leads Aroma360 and its hotel-inspired sister brand from Miami. Their collections began with room scents and diffuser systems, then extended into candles, personal perfume and other lifestyle products. Alongside direct consumer sales, the companies create tailored scents for hotels and other commercial clients. Aroma360 also developed a collection of home and car fragrances for professional basketball teams.
